note: Tricky real one: a professor hiring a research assistant from the exact university domain.
text:
Hi Jesse,

I'm Dr. Ana Morales, a faculty member in the Department of Ecology at the University of Michigan. Your advisor mentioned you're interested in field research, and I have an opening for an undergraduate research assistant in my lab this winter (10 hours a week, $17/hour through the university payroll). Would you be free to meet in my office next Tuesday or Wednesday to talk about it?

Best,
Ana Morales
amorales@umich.edu
